notes: No saying: the report lists the Saduq's routes to Ibrahim b. Abi Mahmud, one group per route.
The third route is split by «؛»: the Ibn al-Walid route ends at سعد بن عبد الله in the text, with no Ibrahim written for it; it is read as it stands, and the chain is incomplete there.
«أبي» (the compiler's father) and «أبيه» are relations with no name in the text; «أبي» is occurrence 3 of that word. The first «إبراهيم بن أبي محمود» is the book's author in the preface, not a link.
